final.object: ABNB close-to-close return (%) on the first trading session after the 3Q26 print: close on 6 Nov 2026 / close on 5 Nov 2026 - 1
final.modes: unimodal but left-shifted: a decelerating-print component (weight ~0.64) centred near -6 to -9 and an accelerating-print component (weight ~0.24) centred near +2 to +5; the density peak sits at about -4 with a long right shoulder

conditional_base_case.definition: 3Q26 nights print decelerates (< 10.09% y/y under the 0.25pt dead band on 2Q26's 10.34%), the 4Q26 revenue guide midpoint is below the LSEG-family Street mean (C01 = Yes), and the 4Q26 nights descriptor is downgraded from 'low double digits' (C02 options c or d)
conditional_base_case.panel_cell: decel & guide below Street & nights guide down-or-stable: n 4 (1Q23 -10.9, 1Q24 -6.9, 2Q24 -13.4, 1Q25 +1.0), mean -7.6 raw, median -8.9; direction-down only n 3 mean -7.8; brief's 'guide below AND nights lower' n 5 mean -8.0 median -10.9 includes two accelerating prints (3Q22, 3Q23)
conditional_base_case.blend: 0.7 model draws conditioned on the cell / 0.3 empirical n-4 cell smoothed with a 4pt Gaussian kernel

conditional_thesis_breaker.definition: accelerating print (>= 10.59%) and 4Q26 guide at or above Street

print_state_probabilities.source: nights ~ N(9.55, 1.48) from the team nowcast band (+9.5, band 8.5-10.0, model path 9.9; reviews index walk-forward RMSE 1.48pp); guide gap ~ N(-1.93 + 0.32 x (nights - 9.55), 2.8) from C01 (median $3,100M vs Street $3,161M)

base_rate.derivation: 23 raw day-1 prints, post-2022 prints weighted 2x, Gaussian kernel bw 3pt

decomposition.derivation: team nowcast band -> P(decel) 0.64; C01 guide-gap distribution; 0.6 S1 sign rule + 0.4 S2 sign+guide-vs-Street; -1.0 positioning term on decel; t5 residual sd 7.5; QQQ N(0,1.3)

anchor.derivation: options-implied event sd, fresh chain 2026-09-17T03:09Z: 16 Oct/20 Nov pair 9.1%, 30 Oct/20 Nov pair 8.0% (thin leg, OI 112), LS one-print 8.2% (LOO 7.9-8.5); B note 12 Sep central 9.5%; two-piece normal, mode -0.3, downside sd x1.10 (25d RR -3.5 vol pts)

estimates.anchor_source: yfinance ABNB chain pulled 2026-09-17T03:09:19Z (16 Sep close $167.51), sources/yfinance_abnb_chain_20260917T030919Z.csv; 20 Nov $170 straddle 13.0% of spot (bid 12.0 / ask 14.1), 16 Oct $170 straddle 7.4%; no 6 Nov weekly listed yet (30 Oct weekly now listed)
estimates.anchor_value: event sd 9.0% (range 8.0-9.5), risk-neutral median about -0.3 to -1.5%
estimates.independence_note: The location (median -2.9, P(<0) 0.62) comes from the repo reaction panel and the team nowcast band and is independent of the options market, which prices no direction; the dispersion is deliberately anchored on the options sd because the 23-print rms (8.9) and the implied sd (9.0-9.5) agree. NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_DERIVED applies to the width, not the location.

sensitivity.moves_to: median -0.1, P(<=-8) 0.19, P(>=+5) 0.27 if centred on the Street bar 11.1 (sd 0.85); median -3.6 / P(<=-8) 0.32 at centre 9.0; median -2.1 / 0.27 at centre 10.1

sensitivity.assumption: 0.6 S1 sign rule / 0.4 S2 guide-vs-Street blend
sensitivity.moves_to: S1 only: median -2.1, P(<=-8) 0.25; S2 only: median -4.0, P(<=-8) 0.35

sensitivity.assumption: positioning term -1.0 on decelerating prints (unobserved accelerating-bar cell)

sensitivity.moves_to: gap at Street: median -2.3, P(<=-8) 0.27; gap -3.5%: median -3.5, P(<=-8) 0.32
decomposition only: median -5.0, P(<=-8) 0.36, P(>=+5) 0.14; equal thirds: median -2.2, P(<=-8) 0.27; base-rate + options only (no repo signal): median -0.9, P(<=-8) 0.22, P(>=+5) 0.25
